summary: Moorea-Maiao is a commune in French Polynesia, an overseas territory of France in the Pacific Ocean. It lies in the Windward Islands subdivision. The note reports its population as 17,816 at the 2017 census.
one_line: Moorea-Maiao is a commune in French Polynesia's Windward Islands, with a population of 17,816 at the 2017 census.
key_facts: Moorea-Maiao is a commune of French Polynesia.
French Polynesia is an overseas territory of France in the Pacific Ocean.
Moorea-Maiao is in the administrative subdivision of the Windward Islands.
Moorea-Maiao had a population of 17,816 at the 2017 census.
